content:
jordan (AE): FYI - Orion signed LOI contingent on capacity + security signoff. Can we do a quick sizing check? They expect spikes ~1.2k qps (90s windows), avg ~250 qps. Workload: 70% chat generation (~1.5k tokens avg), 30% embeddings. Want reserved GPUs + burst autoscale. Also attached security questionnaire link: https://example.com/q-orion :eyes:

sam (SE): thanks. couple quick clarifiers — is 1.5k tokens per chat a hard max or 95th? and what's the desired tail latency SLO (p50/p95/p99)?

jordan (AE): 1.5k is average; 3k token max for long docs (rare). customer needs p95 < 250ms for chat paths, embeddings less strict.

maya (SRE): for that shape i'd recommend Dedicated pool + small burst cluster. rough starter: 6x H100-equivalent reserved for steady-state, 2-3x burst nodes for preheated spikes. give 30% headroom for queueing. KV cache warmup is critical for long contexts.

maya (SRE): autoscale policy i'd use: scale_up: immediate (add nodes when qps>capacity_threshold), scale_down: graceful (10-15m cool-down), burst_allowance: 2x reserved for 5m windows. sample policy snippet:
```json
{
  "reserved_nodes": 6,
  "burst_nodes": 3,
  "scale_up_threshold_qps": 900,
  "scale_down_cooldown_min": 15,
  "prewarm_on_spike": true
}
```

noah (security): noted on questionnaire. Orion requires KMS key policy + customer-managed keys (CMK), SAML SSO, and audit logging for all inference requests. Dedicated + VPC private control plane OK. will need to validate HSM/KMS integration on our side.

liz (finance): pricing check — if we reserve 6 H100-class nodes, ballpark reserved cost ~ $78k/month (committed monthly rate), plus burst/usage + token egress. If they want 12-month commit we can offer stepped credits. need exact model/quantization to refine. @jordan can you confirm term target?

chris (eng-infra): ops caveats: cold-start queueing on big context requests may still push tail. recommend preheat jobs during expected windows and KV cache TTL extended to avoid repeated cold KVs. also set request queuing limit per-client to avoid head-of-line.

sam (SE): i'll draft a one-page POC plan: targets, smoke test (synthetic traffic: 90s spikes to 1.4k qps, steady 250 qps), KV warmup script, throughput & latency dashboards, and acceptance criteria (p95<250ms, no more than 5% dropped requests).

jordan (AE): perfect. also customer asked about quantized model tradeoff to reduce nodes — want a quick comparison (latency vs cost). can you include that?

sam (SE): yep — include 8-bit/4-bit perf estimates and quality caveats.

noah (security): quick blocker: their legal wants data residency confirmation for EU traffic. we'll need region pinning + audit logs retention policy.

jordan (AE): noted, they will pick us if we can sign off on residency + KMS.

maya (SRE): i'll put together a presales runbook and a tentative autoscale config for the POC. will also add prewarm cron + KV warmup step.

capacity-bot: Created presales ticket PS-4721 and invited eng/sales/security.

jordan (AE): thanks all — @sam @maya please sync on the runbook by EOD. I’ll share with Orion tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
